65. (New) A computer-implemented method of providing electronic media for a set of users, the method comprising:identifying, by one or more processors, a group of users, based on:
a presence, for a period of time, by each user in the group of users, each user representing a respective independently controlled vehicle,
an indication of interest by each user in a communication network- mediated interaction with another of the group of users during the period of time, and
trip data for each of the vehicles, wherein the trip data comprises one or more locations associated with an interactive media session for execution by interactive media players, each interactive media player associated with a respective user of the group of users;
selecting or configuring, by the one or more processors and based on the trip data for each of the vehicles and the locations, an interactive media program for execution by the interactive media players; and
providing, by the one or more processors, the interactive media program to the interactive media players during the period of time.

66. (New) The computer-implemented method of claim 65, wherein identifying the group of users is based on profile data for each user, wherein the profile data comprises a respective account identifier for the respective user, and wherein the selecting or configuring is based on an indication, by one or more electronic accounts identified by the account identifiers, that the interactive media program is ready to play.
67. (New) The computer-implemented method of claim 65, wherein the trip data indicates two or more users having substantially similar trip start times, durations, intermediate locations along a route, or end times.
68. (New) The computer-implemented method of claim 65, wherein the trip data defines one or more criteria selected from the group consisting of: a duration for the interactive media session, an initial location at which the session is initiated, and a terminal location at which the session is terminated.
69. (New) The computer-implemented method of claim 65, further comprising, by the one or more processors, defining one or more routes for the vehicles based in part on the interactive media program, and controlling navigation of at least one of the vehicles to facilitate use of the interactive media program by the group of users.
70. (New) The computer-implemented method of claim 65, further comprising playing, by at least one of the interactive media players, the interactive media during the time period.
